mainEntity.name: How long does a typical staircase remodeling project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a staircase remodeling project varies significantly based on the scope and complexity. A cosmetic update like refacing steps might take a few days, while a complete structural redesign and rebuild could span several weeks. Factors such as material availability, unexpected structural issues, or custom fabrication can influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after the initial assessment and design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project length varies from a few days for cosmetic updates to several weeks for full structural redesigns. Scope, material availability, and structural issues impact the timeline.
